images.title: An idli tray chain
images.purpose: Set up the question: an idli tray with 4 of 6 moulds filled, and a chain of blanks for fractions equal to 4/6.
images.composition: One idli tray on the left with wide white space, and one chain line of blanks on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: one flat rectangular tray seen from above with 6 round moulds of the same size in a single row, evenly spaced. The left 4 moulds hold a plain white idli outlined teal #0072B2; the right 2 moulds are empty and plain. The fraction sits above the tray. Right: one chain line in dark text with two blank fraction boxes outlined amber #E69F00, followed by a reddish purple #CC79A7 cue line beneath. Exactly 1 tray, 6 moulds, 4 idlis.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame

the fractions 2/3, 6/9, 8/12 or 10/15 anywhere in the frame
images.takeaway: Divide or multiply the top and the bottom of 4/6 by the same number to grow a chain of equal fractions.
images.description: An idli tray with 6 moulds, 4 filled, labelled 4/6, beside the chain 4/6 = ?/? = ?/? and the cue same number, top and bottom.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say a number that divides both 4 and 6, then a number to multiply by, to fill the blanks.

image_decisions.why: The filled tray keeps 4/6 in view and the blank chain invites the child to build equal fractions.
